slides.title: Images
slides.body:
Ways to add Images in Website
HTML Image
CSS Background Image
Use HTML Image to add an image when there are no content or elements to add on top of the Image.
slides.notes: HTML Image Related to the content – not a design element CSS Background Image Purely used to design – not part of the content Use an tag if it is content related and not just being used as a design element, while background image has nothing to do with the content and is purely a design element.
